variants.name: number-in-name-text
variants.why: Route rows and map labels read "1. Old kiosk" in one text, row buttons are named by their action inside the row, and the dialog lists the ordered stops on one line.

variants.name: native-list-numbers
variants.why: The route is an ordered list whose own markers number the rows; no number is written in the row text.

variants.name: named-buttons-in-group
variants.why: Each row's buttons show the place name ("Remove Old kiosk") and sit in a labelled group inside the list item; the row number stays outside that group.

variants.name: map-legs-and-decor
variants.why: The schematic map has a river and grid lines of its own, draws the route as one line per leg, and groups each marker under the accessible name of its place.

variants.name: sample-route-at-start
variants.why: The brief fixes no opening itinerary: the page starts with two sample stops and Reset route empties it.

variants.name: added-place-leaves-list
variants.why: A place already in the route is no longer listed under Available places, so it cannot be added twice.

variants.name: add-refuses-with-message
variants.why: Add stop stays enabled; pressing it for a place already in the route, or with four stops, adds nothing and says why.

variants.name: empty-route-without-hint
variants.why: The brief asks for no empty-state sentence: an empty route shows only its heading, the stop count and its buttons.
